$comment: Every user-visible feature and protocol capability of Ghostly. Tests declare what they cover with @feature:<id> (Playwright tag) or // covers: <id> (vitest, Rust). scripts/test-map.mjs checks this file against the tags. Edit by hand; keep one feature per line. "paths" maps source globs to the features a change there can break (ids, area.* prefixes, "*" for everything, [] for no e2e): npm run test:affected runs the e2e tests tagged with them, and every spec when a changed file matches no glob.
